result.reason: The clause covers Affiliates and Subcontractors acting on Customer’s behalf and permits transfer to a successor under a permitted assignment, but it does not address paid-up licences or make them perpetual and irrevocable. It also limits every licence to the Agreement term, so it does not fully reach the preferred position. “Subcontractors” may be narrower than all contractors, and deleting “solely” unnecessarily broadens the use restriction, altering unrelated commercial scope. The revocation language is also awkward because a licence stated to exist only during the Agreement term would already end upon termination.
